newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies seven bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies seven bond issues for insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said Wednesday it qualified seven bond issues for insurance slated for competitive sale today.
--West Boylston, Mass., $8.2 million of unlimited tax bonds.
--Cabarrus County, N.C., $49 million of GO bonds.
--Bethlehem, N.Y., $13.5 million of GO school bonds.
--Port Authority of New York and New Jersey $150 million of consolidated bonds and also another $150 million of consolidated bonds.
--Wayland-Cohocton Central School District, N.Y., $9.6 million of GO bonds.
--Indian Area School District, Pa., $9.2 million of GO bonds.
--Greenfield, Wis., $6.9 million of GO refunding bonds.
